conditions.condition_text: Mark the start of the new 4-hour candle at 10:00 a.m. Eastern.
This time is used to define the start of the trading window for the pattern.
Identify the most recent 15-minute fair value gap (FVG) closest to the current price.
The FVG provides the structural target for the manipulation phase.
Wait for a Power of Three (PO3) pattern to form on the 1-minute timeframe, manipulating into the identified 15-minute FVG.
The PO3 signals the accumulation and manipulation phase before the real move.
Enter the trade when a candle body closes through the 15-minute fair value gap.
The candle body closure confirms the entry trigger after the manipulation.
The strategy requires the identification of the most recent 4-hour candlestick to establish context.
Price must be near a recent 15-minute fair value gap.
A Power of Three (PO3) pattern must form on the 1-minute timeframe, manipulating into the 15-minute FVG.
The stop is placed at the high of the 4-hour candle created during the manipulation.
The primary target is the bottom of the accumulation range.
Secondary targets are based on structural liquidity lower down.
